title.sl: Frazni glagoli: get up, look after, turn it off
title.de: Phrasal Verbs: get up, look after, turn it off
title.it: I phrasal verb: get up, look after, turn it off
title.en: Phrasal verbs: get up, look after, turn it off

rule.sl:
**Frazni glagol** je glagol z malo besedo, skupaj pa imata nov pomen: **get up** (vstati), **give up** (odnehati), **look after** (skrbeti za), **look for** (iskati). Spreminja se samo glagol: **got up, gave up, looked after**.

Nekateri nimajo predmeta: **sit down, go out, come back, grow up, set off, break down**: **The van broke down.**

Nekateri imajo predmet in ostanejo skupaj: **look after, look for, get on, get off, run out of**: **Jack looks after the sheep.** **Jack looks after them.** V govoru tudi *get off of the bus*.

Drugi se razdelijo: **turn on, turn off, put on, take off, pick up, throw away, fill in, give back, write down**. Samostalnik stoji na obeh mestih: **Turn off the radio.** = **Turn the radio off.** Zaimek pa samo v sredi: **Turn it off.** (nikoli *Turn off it*).

Britansko je **wash up** (pomivati posodo), **fill in** a form (ameriško **fill out**). Več pomenov, več malih besed: **look up** a word (poiskati besedo), **find out** (izvedeti), **put off** (odložiti).
rule.de:
**Ein Phrasal Verb** ist ein Verb mit einem kleinen Wort, zusammen mit neuer Bedeutung, wie *aufstehen*: **get up** (aufstehen), **give up** (aufgeben), **look after** (sich kümmern um), **look for** (suchen). Nur das Verb ändert sich: **got up, gave up, looked after**.

Manche haben kein Objekt: **sit down, go out, come back, grow up, set off, break down**: **The van broke down.**

Manche haben ein Objekt und bleiben zusammen: **look after, look for, get on, get off, run out of**: **Jack looks after the sheep.** **Jack looks after them.** Gesprochen auch *get off of the bus*.

Andere werden getrennt: **turn on, turn off, put on, take off, pick up, throw away, fill in, give back, write down**. Das Nomen steht an beiden Stellen: **Turn off the radio.** = **Turn the radio off.** Ein Pronomen nur in der Mitte: **Turn it off.** (nie *Turn off it*).

Britisch ist **wash up** (abwaschen), **fill in** a form (amerikanisch **fill out**). Noch mehr: **look up** a word (nachschlagen), **find out** (herausfinden), **put off** (verschieben).
rule.it:
**Un phrasal verb** è un verbo con una parolina, e insieme hanno un significato nuovo, come *buttare via*: **get up** (alzarsi), **give up** (rinunciare), **look after** (occuparsi di), **look for** (cercare). Cambia solo il verbo: **got up, gave up, looked after**.

Alcuni non hanno oggetto: **sit down, go out, come back, grow up, set off, break down**: **The van broke down.**

Alcuni hanno un oggetto e restano uniti: **look after, look for, get on, get off, run out of**: **Jack looks after the sheep.** **Jack looks after them.** A voce anche *get off of the bus*.

Altri si dividono: **turn on, turn off, put on, take off, pick up, throw away, fill in, give back, write down**. Il nome sta in tutti e due i posti: **Turn off the radio.** = **Turn the radio off.** Un pronome solo in mezzo: **Turn it off.** (mai *Turn off it*).

È britannico **wash up** (lavare i piatti), **fill in** a form (americano **fill out**). Ancora: **look up** a word (cercare una parola), **find out** (scoprire), **put off** (rimandare).
rule.en:
**A phrasal verb** is a verb with a small word, and together they have a new meaning: **get up**, **give up**, **look after**, **look for**. Only the verb changes: **got up, gave up, looked after**.

Some have no object: **sit down, go out, come back, grow up, set off, break down**: **The van broke down.**

Some have an object and stay together: **look after, look for, get on, get off, run out of**: **Jack looks after the sheep.** **Jack looks after them.** In talk also *get off of the bus*.

Others can part: **turn on, turn off, put on, take off, pick up, throw away, fill in, give back, write down**. A noun can stand in both places: **Turn off the radio.** = **Turn the radio off.** A pronoun only in between: **Turn it off.** (never *Turn off it*).

British: **wash up** (the dishes), **fill in** a form (American **fill out**). More: **look up** a word, **find out**, **put off** (until later).

rule.sl: Glagol + mala beseda = nov pomen: **get up**, **look after**. Spreminja se samo glagol: **got up**. Nekateri ostanejo skupaj: **look after them**. Drugi se razdelijo: **Turn the radio off.** Zaimek v sredi: **Turn it off.**
rule.de: Verb + kleines Wort = neue Bedeutung: **get up**, **look after**. Nur das Verb ändert sich: **got up**. Manche bleiben zusammen: **look after them**. Andere werden getrennt: **Turn the radio off.** Ein Pronomen in der Mitte: **Turn it off.**
rule.it: Verbo + parolina = significato nuovo: **get up**, **look after**. Cambia solo il verbo: **got up**. Alcuni restano uniti: **look after them**. Altri si dividono: **Turn the radio off.** Un pronome in mezzo: **Turn it off.**
rule.en: Verb + small word = a new meaning: **get up**, **look after**. Only the verb changes: **got up**. Some stay together: **look after them**. Others can part: **Turn the radio off.** A pronoun in between: **Turn it off.**

tip.sl: 💡 Pomena ne sestaviš iz delov: **give up** = odnehati.
tip.en: 💡 Learn each one as one word: **give up**, **look after**.
